right.name: table
right.use_when: Labelled numbers that need exact reading: comps, precedents, sources & uses, deal terms, one-way sensitivities (down / base / up), KPI lists with change vs prior period, requirements with detail
right.dont_use_when: A trend over time (use a chart); ranking many players on one metric (use bar); 3-6 headline numbers with no extra columns (use stat_strip)

right.name: Benchmarking bar matrix

right.dont_use_when: One metric (use bk22); more than 8 peers

picked.name: Ranked columns with median line

picked.dont_use_when: Change in a multiple across peers, in % or x turns (use bk21); the same multiple for 2+ years or bases side by side (use bk32); many metrics at once (use bk32/bk33)
